description: This Java source file defines the GenericDispatcherFactory class, which implements the LocalDispatcherFactory interface. It provides methods to create and manage LocalDispatcher instances, including a nested class GenericDispatcher that handles synchronous and asynchronous service execution, enabling/disabling ECA, and managing transaction settings within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcherFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating LocalDispatcher instances within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcher
classes.description: A nested static class extending GenericAbstractDispatcher, implementing methods for synchronous and asynchronous service execution, transaction management, and ECA control.

methods.name: createLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a LocalDispatcher instance by name, initializing a new GenericDispatcher if necessary.

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks if ECA is currently disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with optional transaction timeout and requirement.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously with various overloads for context and request handling.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter for the result.
